pw.title: Policies
pw.sub: The pages customers read before they order. Write each one in English and Bengali, check it in the preview, then publish.
pw.note: Your own words only: nothing is written for you. A page with no words stays a draft and does not show on the shop.
pw.previewHelp: This is how the page reads on the shop. A blank line starts a new paragraph, “## ” starts a heading and “- ” starts a list line.
pw.sharedNote: The shop already had this page. Its words are the same ones as in Settings › Policies & texts, so a change there shows here as a new version.
pw.published: Published — the shop shows it now
pw.restored: Version {v} brought back as a new draft
pw.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved. Leave anyway?
pw.readOnly: You can look at these pages. Changing them needs the settings permission.
pw.historyHelp: Every version is kept. Restoring one makes a new draft; nothing is ever removed.
pw.noHistory: No versions yet. Save a draft to start the history.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Check the words: fill both English and Bengali for each box you use, and write the page text before publishing
err.STALE: Someone else changed this page. Reload and try again
err.PLACEHOLDER: Replace the stand-in text in square brackets with the real words
err.UNKNOWN_TOKEN: A rule number in the words does not match any rule
err.NO_DRAFT: There is no draft to publish
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this
